hebrewText: מִ/בֹּ֣קֶר לָ/עֶ֣רֶב יֻכַּ֑תּוּ מִ/בְּלִ֥י מֵ֝שִׂ֗ים לָ/נֶ֥צַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ

tokens.bdb: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning

tokens.kjv: beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp. l

tokens.bdb: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
tokens.kjv: corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to put (used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: properly, a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (i.e. to the most distant point of view)
tokens.kjv: alway(-s), constantly, end, ([phrase] n-) ever(more), perpetual, strength, victory.

tokens.bdb: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
tokens.kjv: break, destroy(-uction), [phrase] not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, [idiom] and surely, take, be undone, [idiom] utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.
